description: Labelled ground-truth corpus for engagement-audit's deterministic checks (EN-05, EN-06, EN-07, EN-09). EN-01/EN-03 are agent-judged and have no script verdict to measure this way — see references/engagement-judgement-rubric.md for their calibration examples instead. expected_findings entries are matched as ID PREFIXES (not exact equality) because EN-06's id includes a content hash suffix. Every fixture carries a valid viewport meta tag unless a case is specifically testing EN-05, so EN-05 does not pollute unrelated cases.
